[Bug] Dashboard memory leak ### Search before asking - [X] I searched the [issues](https://github.com/ray-project/ray/issues) and found no similar issues. ### Ray Component Dashboard ### What happened + What you expected to happen Ray dashboard keeps the whole history of actors and never delete the old ones. So as time going, it'll OOM. This issue is a follow up for this one https://github.com/ray-project/ray/issues/21432 many drivers test eventually OOM because we are running faster than before and as dashboard memory keeps increasing, it eventually OOM. ### Versions / Dependencies master ### Reproduction script many driver nightly tests ### Anything else _No response_ ### Are you willing to submit a PR? - [ ] Yes I am willing to submit a PR!
